dict.string: Patchfleet accesses the project folder you select to run your local agents. Project files stay on this Mac.
Patchfleet accesses a project folder you select on your Desktop. Project files stay on this Mac.
Patchfleet accesses a project folder you select in Downloads. Project files stay on this Mac.
Patchfleet accesses the project folder you select on a removable drive to run your local agents.
Patchfleet accesses the project folder you select on a network drive to run your local agents.
